name: NyxID
description:
Agent Connectivity Gateway — turn any authenticated API into an MCP Server. Self-hosted reverse proxy with OAuth 2.0/OIDC credential injection, per-agent isolation,
NAT traversal for localhost services, and REST-to-MCP auto-wrap from OpenAPI specs. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex. Rust.
